notes.title: Force of Nature: Multiplayer
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27148173/abb4426ef0123df9876edaca78db9e4164f6e7ef.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello Everyone![/b]

Welcome to the biggest update since the game was released! Multiplayer game mode is now available! Currently this mode has the status "Beta", but it is already fully functional.

[b]The main features:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can only play in co-op mode and only with Steam friends
[*]In "General" world maximum 2 players can play simultaneously, in the "Creative" world - 4 players. You cannot play Hardcore world on net
[*]Inventory, equipment and craft progress of guests is saved, so you can leave the game at any time and continue playing later
[*]Only the game host can get new level and pick up important for the progress items (like a gem at the very beginning of the game and the Force of Nature shards). All other features are available to guests
[*]The ability to put a mark on the map is added to coordinate the players. Just open the map and click anywhere - your friends will also see this mark
[/list]

In the near future, I also plan to add player customization.

tags.feature: Multiplayer game mode is now available!
The ability to put a mark on the map is added to coordinate the players. Just open the map and click anywhere - your friends will also see this mark
